$comment: Schema and example for docs/ROADMAP.json. Sprint skill reads/writes this file as the source of truth for all sprint tracking.

$rules.user_story_format: {役割}として、{やりたいこと}をしたい。なぜなら、{理由・価値}だから。 — Task decompositions ('〜を実装する') are not valid stories.
$rules.acceptance_criteria: Write as verifiable user behavior ('〜ができる'), not implementation ('〜が実装されている'). GUI stories get Playwright test scenarios from gui-spec.
$rules.sprint_id: Random 6-char lowercase hex with 'S' prefix: Sa3f9c2, Sb1e4d8, Sc7d2a1. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 3` and prepend 'S'. Random IDs prevent collisions when multiple worktrees create Sprints in parallel. IDs are permanent — never change or reuse. Creation/execution order is tracked via the execution_order array, NOT the ID itself. Existing sequential IDs (S001, S002...) from older projects remain valid and must not be renamed.
$rules.progress_rules: Only one sprint can be in_progress at a time. A story is done only when all tasks are done. A sprint is done only when all stories are done.
$rules.milestone: Set to true at natural review points. sprint plan and sprint roadmap manage milestone placement.
$rules.compaction: When a Sprint reaches status `done`, `sprint done` first writes the full Sprint entry to `docs/sprint-logs/{SprintID}/sprint.json` (see SPRINT_LOGS_SCHEMA.json `sprint`), then replaces the entry in this file with the compact form: {title, status, milestone, snapshot, stories: {<StoryID>: {title, status}, ...}}. Description, user_story, acceptance_criteria, tasks are dropped from ROADMAP.json — they live in the snapshot. This keeps ROADMAP.json focused on active work without losing any history. Sprints with status `partial`/`blocked`/`needs_human` are NOT compacted.

Sa3f9c2.$comment: Compact form. status=done Sprints are stored this way after sprint done compacts them. Full body lives at the snapshot path.
Sa3f9c2.title: Sprint title

Sb1e4d8.$comment: Full form. in_progress / pending / partial / blocked Sprints keep all fields. Compaction happens only at sprint done.
